from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached flight search results for outbound and return legs
outbound_cache_key = "departure_flights"
return_cache_key = "return_flights"
outbound_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=outbound_cache_key)
return_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=return_cache_key)

# Define search parameters for outbound flight (Las Vegas to Colorado Springs, May 21, 2025)
outbound_search = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Las Vegas",
    end_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
    departure_date=["May 21, 2025"],
    flight_class=["business", "first"],
    budget=1100,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    layover_1_duration_minutes=60
)

# Define search parameters for return flight (Colorado Springs to Las Vegas, May 31, 2025)
return_search = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
    end_airport_city="Las Vegas",
    departure_date=["May 31, 2025"],
    flight_class=["business", "first"],
    budget=1100,
    num_layovers=[0, 1],
    layover_1_duration_minutes=60
)

# Save search results to cache with unique keys
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights_search", value=outbound_search)
save_to_cache(key="return_flights_search", value=return_search)

# Filter results based on budget constraint (under $1100)
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=outbound_prior_results,
    budget=1100
)

filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_prior_results,
    budget=1100
)

# Save filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights", value=filtered_outbound)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# No further action needed; results are ready for presentation
print("No planning needed")
